title: Aim a part with a ball-and-socket joint
applicability: Use for a small lug, limb or control surface that needs to tilt about more than one axis. The neck must clear the lip of the matching socket during the intended swing.
aliases: ball joint for a poseable limb
steps: Fix a 14418 socket plate near a support edge to leave both the neck and the attached lug room to swing. Mate the 22890 towball at the socket center.

Choose the rest orientation before assigning motion. The example clocks the lug away from the deck and uses a small one-axis swing. When you add axes, inspect combined settings as well as each isolated tilt.
Check the socket rim, the ball neck and attached geometry during the requested motion. A range that clears the rigid geometry still needs physical evidence for retention, friction and real stops.
expected: The lug records a ball joint, changes orientation at a 5° swing, and clears the five samples from −5° to +5°.

sources.author: Carlos Antelo
sources.title: Build with studs facing sideways
sources.adaptation: Reference only. The articulated uses of ball sockets informed the example's choice of attachment. The BrickWright guidance and example are original.
